library.name: three.js (with OrbitControls and GLTFLoader)
library.description: JavaScript 3D library used to render the anatomy models.

library.name: BodyParts3D anatomy models (Brain)
library.description: Verified 3D anatomy geometry from BodyParts3D, converted from binary STL to GLB (vertices welded, meshes simplified for the web, smooth normals, axes normalised; some structures merged from several source meshes). Original FMA identifiers are kept in pack.json. Attribution in ATTRIBUTION.txt.
